Diagnostics

High Angle of Attack
|α| reached 51.5° during flight — may indicate MPC solver timeouts on ARM64
High Angular Rate
ω reached 1337°/s — tumbling risk
No Control Commands
PX4 rocket_mpc sent near-zero fin commands — check ARM state
Servo Tracking Degraded
MAE = 1.73° (limit 1.5°) — marginal; may affect precision
Frequent Large Tracking Errors
25.1% of samples have |err| > 2° — servo slew rate or CAN jitter issue
Servo Feedback Stale Periods
6.8% of steps used last-known CAN angle (stale feedback) — intermittent CAN dropouts
Servo Offline Events
All 4 servos online only 89% of time — check CAN bus connections
No Timing Data
hil_timing.csv is empty — 'adb reverse tcp:5760 tcp:5760' may not be set, or MAVLink DEBUG_VECT stream is not enabled
Servo Delay Under-Compensated
MPC commands arrive too late for servo — increase RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY. Symptoms: roll reached 129° (should be <10°); pitch σ=22.1° in terminal (should be <4°); |α| reached 51.5° (should be <12°); servo tracking P95=9.2° (large transient lag)

Recommendations

Verify PX4 is armed and rocket_mpc module is running — fin commands are near-zero
Range error is -69.7% — tune MPC guidance gains or verify thrust curve
High in-flight AoA — consider lowering qp_solver_cond_N further or reducing N_horizon
Pitch oscillation in terminal phase — check damping gains and actuator bandwidth
Servo tracking MAE=1.73° exceeds 1.5° limit — check fin mechanical play, servo_auto_zero calibration, CAN bus speed
Significant CAN dropout — check wiring, connector seating, servo_feedback_timeout_ms in hil_config.yaml
⚠ SERVO DELAY: Increase RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY to ~0.100s (estimated from tracking P95=9.2° + 40ms overhead). This gives lookahead_stage=5. For precise value: measure cmd→can lag on bench.
Enable timing capture: ensure 'adb reverse tcp:5760 tcp:5760' and PX4 publishes DEBUG_VECT 'TIMING' with fields mhe_us/mpc_us/cycle_us
